title: Shared ContextPlanner, Condensation and Compact Handoffs

control_plane.zetsu_mutation_note: The repaired read-only repository-agent proof passed without per_user_worktree_quota. The bounded mutating delegation remained deterministically blocked by the stale promotion target (zetsu_agent_apply_target_not_clean); local implementation was used under the documented fallback, and the production control-plane checkout was not modified.

implementation.core_integration: LaplaceCore exposes one shared ContextPlanner instance; ZetsuAgentCoordinator uses it for context assembly, compaction prompts and compaction-trigger decisions.
authoritative_invariants: Exact task state is serialized separately and fingerprinted; the planner never asks a summary to reconstruct it.
Owner/session authorization, policy and required verifier fingerprints are preserved across compaction.
Rules remain explicitly authoritative while memory, RepoMap, retrieval and semantic narration remain advisory.
Only narration and recent-history fields are bounded/compacted; exact state, policy, commands, provenance and verifier evidence are not summarized.
Compaction ratio remains 0.80, validated to the existing 0.75–0.85 policy range.
Repeated compaction reconstructs the same deterministic plan and restart produces byte-identical messages for identical inputs.

security_and_negative.bandit_note: Bandit returned zero high-severity findings; its manager emitted only warnings from security-comment words such as argv/shell/allowlisted.

persistence_and_recovery.restart_resume: A fresh ContextPlanner reconstructed byte-identical messages and identical authorization/exact-state fingerprints from the same inputs.
persistence_and_recovery.repeated_compaction: Six consecutive compactions retained exact state, policy and required verifier values and remained below the controlled 131072-token context limit estimate.
persistence_and_recovery.threshold: The existing 0.80 trigger is now delegated to ContextPlanner.should_compact and remains bounded by the accepted 0.75–0.85 range.
persistence_and_recovery.summary_boundary: Semantic summaries are explicitly advisory and separate from the authoritative state/policy/verifier sections.

comparison.method: The structured planner was compared with the prior coordinator handoff on controlled histories and the full existing compaction/checkpoint coding regression. Correctness and security were preserved; exact fields remain explicit in both paths.
comparison.reason: The deterministic planner improves authority separation and repeatable bounds, but no material Codex-context or local-model token reduction was measured on CPU-only controlled fixtures. Keep compact handoff optimization in SHADOW until a frozen local-model workload demonstrates benefit without correctness loss.
comparison.task_aware_reasoning_budget_decision: NOT_EVALUATED; deferred until stable planner measurements exist

limitations: SHADOW lifecycle is intentional because compact handoff efficiency has not been measured against a real local-model workload.

The planner API accepts rules, memory, RepoMap and retrieval evidence; the existing agent coordinator currently supplies its trajectory, exact state and policy while higher-level Core callers may provide the other sections.
Token counts use the repository's deterministic UTF-8 bytes-divided-by-four estimate where no tokenizer is exposed; this is not a production model tokenizer claim.

The existing Zetsu repository-agent registry remains stale relative to the current v2 checkout; local implementation was used after the deterministic promotion-target failure recorded in prior certifications.
The socket-concurrency regression requires host socket permission because the restricted shell denies socket creation; the selected unchanged suite passed under that permission.
The full G0 production certification was not repeated, per the roadmap instruction and prior phase certifications.

rollback_target.description: G6-certified shadow bounded ACI with G5/G4/G3/G2/G1 capabilities and production/v1 remaining separately immutable.
